title: Frozen local deterministic replay validation protocol

scope.purpose: Test a tiny deterministic replay validator using explicit synthetic fixtures; this is not evidence about live-model behavior or production test-selection efficacy.
scope.execution: Python standard library and local files only. No API, network, package installation, upload, or live model calls.
scope.freeze_order: Freeze public fixtures, hidden goal checker, and this protocol before implementing or evaluating replay, mutations, or selectors.
scope.frozen_file_policy: Any modification to a frozen payload invalidates the original freeze and requires a separately named protocol revision and manifest; never silently replace frozen evidence.

public_task_schema.family: One of A, P, E, R; four tasks per family.
public_task_schema.prompt: User-level goal and operational constraints; no expected answer or mutation label.
public_task_schema.capabilities: Descriptive public capability tags; never fault labels, outcome labels, or hidden checker values.

fixture_contract.A: Exact identifier or nested-query fidelity, including case and Unicode.
fixture_contract.P: Complete ordered collection reads, including single-page, long international-text, and empty-page continuation cases.
fixture_contract.E: Temporary read recovery; one committed keyed write despite a post-commit timeout; permanent rejection without resubmission; missing primary with backup.
fixture_contract.R: Exact lookup before conditional search, including direct hit, international nested query, and paginated fallback search.
fixture_contract.goal_answers: Defined exclusively by hidden_checker.py and excluded from all selector-visible inputs.

response_tapes.interpretation: Two individually named finite hand-authored response tapes per task, not sampled model trajectories. Count identical or near-identical tapes transparently; they do not establish statistical independence.
response_tapes.request_binding: Every scripted response is bound to a complete serialized old model request. The tape entry contains that complete request and response, not just a task identifier or step ordinal.
response_tapes.sequence: Freeze each fully authored tape before replay comparisons; keep its content hash with run provenance. No tape edits based on mutation outcomes or selection results.
nonclaims: No live model requests were made.
No probability, reliability, or empirical generalization claim follows from two scripted tapes.

local_synthetic_mutations.mechanism: Change argument normalization in the local argument path.
Change cursor handling or observation truncation in the local pagination path.
Change the local retry or keyed-operation idempotency path.
End local execution before the task goal is reached.

controls.mechanism: A global prompt change that changes the complete next model request.
A structural refactor with intentionally equivalent observable behavior.

mutation_matrix.treatment: Each change is applied independently to the same frozen baseline; do not compound changes.
mutation_matrix.selector_visibility: Mutation names, mechanisms, failure sets, checker results, and new-run outcomes are never selector inputs.

boundary_comparison.method: Walk old and new execution together, comparing every complete observable boundary before allowing the next step.
boundary_comparison.complete_model_request: Compare all serialized request fields, including full prompt/messages, tools/schema, options, and all context sent. Do not compare a subset, normalize away distinctions, or use only a digest without preserving auditable serialized content.
boundary_comparison.tool_dispatch: Compare tool name, complete arguments, and stable operation key where applicable before dispatching. Text is case- and code-point-sensitive; nested values and array order are preserved.
boundary_comparison.tool_observation: Compare the complete serialized observation, including empty values, errors, continuation tokens, long text, and Unicode. Never truncate comparison inputs.
boundary_comparison.termination_or_budget: Compare termination reason and answer, model-request count, tool-dispatch count, and exhausted-budget state. Different early stopping or limit exhaustion is a boundary difference.
boundary_comparison.first_difference: Stop at the first differing complete request, tool dispatch/arguments, observation, or termination/budget boundary and report its kind and index.
boundary_comparison.response_consumption: Check request equality before consuming a tape entry. A differing complete model request consumes zero responses for that boundary. No response from the tape is consumed after any divergence.
boundary_comparison.exactness: Use deterministic lossless JSON serialization with sorted object keys for stable ordering; no Unicode normalization, case folding, whitespace stripping inside strings, cursor shortening, or list reordering.
boundary_comparison.unsupported_continuation: A replay that diverges establishes a boundary difference only. Do not fabricate a continuation or claim a final goal failure from an unconsumed tape.
boundary_comparison.separate_scripted_runs: If standalone mutant goal outcomes are evaluated, use separately authored and pre-frozen request-bound scripted fixtures, label them independently, and do not present them as continuation of a divergent replay.

budgets.accounting: Increment counters for actual attempted model-request boundaries and actual tool dispatches. Reaching a limit is recorded explicitly; disallow execution beyond the public limit.

hidden_goal_checker.interface: check(task_id, answer, state, transcript) -> {"passed": bool, "reason": str}

answer_shape.result: Exact task-specific scalar string or ordered list of strings.

state_shape.committed_writes: Integer number of committed writes; required by the E2 goal check.

transcript_dispatch_shape.other_fields: Preserved execution evidence; exact dispatch counting uses kind.

hidden_goal_checker.goal_rules: Exact goal result for every task. Only E2 additionally requires exactly one committed write. Only E3 additionally requires exactly one tool_dispatch.
hidden_goal_checker.independence: No mutation, replay, selector, or evaluation code is imported by the checker. Its expected answers are fixed before those implementations.
hidden_goal_checker.visibility: The selector must have no callable handle, import, file read, result view, or indirect view of this module or its outcomes. The evaluator invokes the checker only outside selection.
hidden_goal_checker.isolation_claim: State and verify the actual mechanism used to restrict selector inputs; do not claim operating-system isolation unless it is implemented and tested.

selector_inputs.structural_diff_ids: Stable opaque component or structural-change identifiers only; not semantic mutation labels or outcome annotations.
selector_inputs.old_exposures: Components or boundary categories exercised by the frozen old runs. No new-run coverage or hidden outcome information.
selector_inputs.historical_scripted_costs: Costs measured from frozen old scripted runs under the synthetic accounting below; no live-model or billed-cost inputs.
selector_inputs.ids: Task and tape IDs may identify selectable units; they are not additional engineered outcome features.
forbidden: hidden checker module or expected answers
new-run costs as selector features beyond declared historical scripted costs
goal truth derived from hand-authored transcripts
raw request, argument, observation, or answer payloads in the selector view
selector_inputs.output_freeze: Persist selection sets, ranking, scores, and input-view hashes after deriving only allowed pre-outcome structural evidence, and before any evaluator computes hidden goal outcomes. Structural evidence generation must never invoke or read the hidden goal checker.
selector_inputs.first_valid_divergence_features: Location/index and kind of the first differing observable boundary, or equivalent-to-termination, from an actual deterministic old/new replay that stops before dispatching different arguments or consuming a response for a different request. May include only the structural comparable-prefix extent, never observation text, answer values, mutation labels, hidden goals, or any post-divergence material.
selector_inputs.construction_accounting: Record guarded replay work used to build first-valid-divergence features separately from selected-test execution cost. Include feature-construction overhead in any end-to-end synthetic work comparison, so full replay of all candidates is not presented as free selection.

selection_baselines.description: Ascending historical scripted cost with stable task/tape ID tie-break.
Greedy previously uncovered structural diff IDs intersected with old exposures, per historical scripted cost; stable ID tie-break.
Use structural-diff/old-exposure overlap and public capability coverage with historical scripted cost; declare the exact deterministic scoring rule before outcomes.

candidate_decision.requirement: A candidate needs a unique mechanism signal beyond simple changed-component coverage and public tags. Audited first-valid-divergence location/type may provide such structural signal only if it distinguishes outcomes of the boundary validator beyond those baselines; it is not a hidden goal label. Different ordering, tie-break, score scale, or sorting of otherwise identical evidence is insufficient.
candidate_decision.gate: If no separately identified and implemented mechanism signal distinguishes structural detection from the simple baselines, record NO-GO for candidate novelty; do not rename a baseline as a candidate.
candidate_decision.evidence: Compare selected sets and unique structural detections at equal declared synthetic execution budgets, accounting separately and inclusively for replay-feature construction costs. Use legitimate first-valid-divergence evidence only. Preserve no-op/refactor and global-prompt control results. If the optional local-predicate diagnostic is run, explicitly test whether simple label-free changed guards/transforms reproduce the claimed distinguishing signal.
candidate_decision.limits: No asserted superiority, production readiness, economic return, benchmark win, or generalization from structural fixture counts.

synthetic_cost.definition: 1 synthetic unit per attempted model-request boundary plus 1 synthetic unit per actual tool dispatch; report the two counters separately as well.
synthetic_cost.meaning: Local scripted bookkeeping only. No API call is made and no billed currency is represented.
synthetic_cost.comparison: Use identical declared synthetic budgets and deterministic tie-breaks for candidate and baselines.

allowed: counts of hidden goal pass/fail when a complete valid standalone scripted run exists
raw synthetic model-request and dispatch counts
set overlaps and unique structural detections
reporting.inconclusive: Diverged replay without a complete separately valid run has no final goal label. Report the boundary difference and unknown goal outcome.
minimum_audit: 224 fully crossed change/task/tape units accounted for or explicitly missing
first-valid-divergence features contain only permitted structural data
feature construction never invokes hidden goal checker
replay-feature construction overhead separately and inclusively accounted for

revision_history.change: Clarification received before implementation: allow audited first-valid-divergence structural evidence as a candidate input, excluding hidden outcomes and all invalid continuation.
Clarification received before implementation: add optional label-free local-predicate diagnostic to test whether simple changed transforms/guards reproduce apparent replay signal.

optional_local_predicate_diagnostic.purpose: Check whether signal apparently gained from first-valid-divergence replay is already available from executing simple changed local transforms or guards against recorded old-run contexts.
optional_local_predicate_diagnostic.procedure: For each of the four local synthetic edits, evaluate the actual old and changed transform/guard on the same already recorded H0 boundary context. Compare their outputs or control decision without executing a model continuation or calling the goal checker. Preserve enough structural provenance to match the local diagnostic to the corresponding replay boundary.
permitted_evidence: exact equality/difference of local transform output or guard decision
optional_local_predicate_diagnostic.reporting: Report structural agreement/disagreement counts and local-predicate work, not effectiveness or goal-failure claims. Raw contexts and output payloads stay outside the selector view.
optional_local_predicate_diagnostic.interpretation: If the local predicate reproduces the distinguishing structural signal, do not present that signal as uniquely requiring full replay. Sorting differences remain insufficient; report the simpler explanation and NO-GO for a claimed full-replay-specific mechanism.
optional_local_predicate_diagnostic.status: Optional diagnostic; cheapest-first, changed-component coverage, and diff+capability remain the three required baselines.
